mapping_rule: preserve language_id,record identity,frequency facts, and source fingerprint
frequency remains metadata and never becomes token identity
preserve exact source identity, coordinates, and multi-target relation order
preserve direction and relation identity; never synthesize synonyms
never download or redistribute an external dataset through the receiver
preserve concept, language, lexeme, profile, and provenance coordinates
preserve source and target language IDs plus fingerprint-guarded projections
preserve canonical name, symbol, dimensions, exponent, offset, and prefixability
preserve acronym and expansion identities; targeted admission remains unresolved
retain every integer ID from 0 through 10000 and language-scoped spelling
preserve vocabulary scope, token order, and left-to-right longest-prefix semantics
reject mismatched source fingerprints before reusing translated token IDs
keep delete keys, frequencies, configuration, and source fingerprint lexicon-scoped
keep byte digests and range fingerprints tied to immutable token space
keep prefix arrays value-scoped and never global lexicon identity
keep frequency folds derived from canonical token IDs
preserve immutable instance identity, type, language, aliases, provenance, and precompute facts
preserve title-to-instance identity, language, title type, creators, provenance, and precompute facts
preserve String compatibility while treating segmented storage and precomputed facts as internal projections
no external corpus or language-specific n-gram payload enters M3JDK without source/license proof
do not map unrelated Rapidex repositories into a lexicon or M3JDK receiver
